title: Acute Abdominal Distress
chiefComplaint: Severe pain in the lower right side of my stomach since early morning.
urgentOrders: NPO (Nil Per Os) order for surgery prep

goldenQuestions.answer: It began around 3 AM as a dull, crampy ache around my navel, but by 7 AM it shifted down to my lower right side and became sharp and constant.
Yes, I felt intensely nauseated and threw up twice this morning after the pain moved.
Yes, I've had shivering chills since breakfast and feel hot to the touch.
Zero appetite. The thought of food makes me want to throw up.
No burning or blood when I urinate, just regular urination.
I haven't passed stool or gas since last evening. Feels constipated.
Every bump on the road or cough makes my lower right abdomen throb agonizingly.

pupilReflex.finding: Pupils Equal, Round, and Reactive to Light (PERRLA). Mild conjunctival dehydration.

palpation.finding: Marked tenderness at McBurney's Point. Involuntary muscle guarding. Positive rebound tenderness and positive Rovsing's sign.

physicalExam.chestAuscultation: Bilateral air entry normal. Tachycardia without murmurs.

defaultResponse: I feel really sick, doctor. The pain is centered in my lower right abdomen and it hurts whenever I move or breathe deeply.

title: Acute Crushing Chest Pain
chiefComplaint: Crushing chest tightness and heaviness, feels like an elephant sitting on my chest.
urgentOrders: Activate Cardiac Cath Lab for Emergency PCI

goldenQuestions.answer: The pain is right in the center of my chest and radiates down my left arm and up into my left jaw.
Yes, I am sweating profusely and drenched in cold sweat.
I can't take a full breath, I feel suffocated and air-hungry.
I have been smoking a pack a day for 25 years.
I have high blood pressure and Type-2 Diabetes for 8 years, but I frequently forget my medications.
It started 45 minutes ago while climbing the office stairs and has not relieved with rest.

pupilReflex.finding: PERRLA. Pupils dilated secondary to sympathetic drive/stress.

palpation.finding: Cold, clammy, diaphoretic skin. S4 gallop heard on cardiac auscultation. Bilateral lung bases clear.

physicalExam.chestAuscultation: Tachycardia, S4 audible, mild bibasilar inspiratory rales.

defaultResponse: Please help, doctor. It's a crushing heaviness in the center of my chest, and I feel lightheaded and drenched in cold sweat.

title: Severe Respiratory Distress
chiefComplaint: I can barely breathe... my blue inhaler... isn't working at all...
urgentOrders: Supplemental High-Flow Oxygen to maintain SpO2 94-98%
Urgent Arterial Blood Gas (ABG) & Peak Expiratory Flow

goldenQuestions.answer: (Gasping) Took 6 puffs... of my rescue inhaler... in the last hour... zero relief...
Was cleaning... an old dusty storage closet... in my dorm this morning...
(Struggles to speak more than 2-3 words per breath).
Admitted to ICU... two years ago... for a severe attack...
Dry... tight hacking cough... no phlegm...

pupilReflex.finding: PERRLA. Wide eyes, visible accessory muscle use (sternocleidomastoid retractions).

palpation.finding: Intercostal retractions, suprasternal indrawing, marked respiratory fatigue.

physicalExam.chestAuscultation: Widespread high-pitched expiratory wheezing bilaterally, prolonged expiratory phase.

defaultResponse: I... can't breathe... chest feels... locked shut...
